title: The Master's Reach Reference
summary: The Master's Reach is a 0.5.4 unique glove from the fully empowered Vessel of Kulemak. This guide covers its modifiers, the Untether skill, build fit, and roll priority.
description: A source-linked reference for The Master's Reach unique gloves: modifiers, granted Untether skill, acquisition, build usage, and roll priority.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: The Master's Reach unique gloves item icon - dark tethering bands that grant the Untether skill

sections.title: Quick answer
sections.callout: The Master's Reach is a unique glove that drops from a fully empowered Vessel of Kulemak. It reveals weaknesses, grants the Untether skill, and got Martial Artist support in 0.5.4b.
calloutDetail: It fits builds that can exploit Open Weakness and want the Soul Eater payoff.
Martial Artist builds gained special support in 0.5.4b.

answers.label: Farm it
text: Target the fully empowered Vessel of Kulemak in the Vaal Temple.

answers.label: Buy it
text: Buy if the roll is good and the price beats the farm time.

answers.label: Skip it
text: Skip if your build cannot use Open Weakness or Soul Eater.

sections.title: Modifiers
paragraphs: The gloves provide a defensive base of armour and energy shield plus life and intelligence, making them a solid defensive unique on their own.
Their signature modifiers are Reveal Weakness and the Soul Eater buff that activates against Open Weakness targets, plus a Recoup effect when taking specific damage types.

sections.title: Granted skill: Untether
paragraphs: The Master's Reach grants the Untether skill, an active ability you can slot and use in combat.
Because it is item-granted, it does not occupy a normal skill gem socket, and its level scales with the item. Check the in-game tooltip for the exact effect on your client version.
bullets: Active skill granted by the item.
Does not use a skill gem socket.

sections.title: Effect breakdown
paragraphs: Reveal Weakness marks enemies so that their weaknesses become exploitable. Against targets that are already Open Weakness, Soul Eater triggers, giving a stacking or burst payoff depending on the current client.
Recoup recovers a portion of life when you take the specific damage types the item lists; it is not a general heal and does not cover every damage source.
Untether is the active skill you gain, providing an additional combat option beyond the passive modifiers.
bullets: Reveal Weakness -> enables Open Weakness payoff.
Soul Eater triggers versus Open Weakness targets.
Recoup is conditional on listed damage types.
Untether is the granted active skill.

sections.title: Acquisition
intro: The Master's Reach drops from the Vessel of Kulemak when that boss is fully empowered.

routes.label: Vessel of Kulemak (fully empowered)
body: Reach and fully empower the Vessel of Kulemak in the Vaal Temple to get a chance at this unique.

routes.label: Trade
body: Buy from other players if you prefer to skip the farm.

sections.title: Drop conditions
paragraphs: The key condition is that the Vessel of Kulemak must be fully empowered by the Liches before it can drop The Master's Reach. A partially empowered fight does not meet the drop condition.
Plan your temple route so the Vessel reaches full empowerment, then face it for the unique drop chance.
bullets: Fully empower the Vessel of Kulemak first.

sections.title: Build usage
intro: The gloves reward builds that can create and exploit Open Weakness and benefit from the granted skill.

builds.title: Martial Artist
builds.description: 0.5.4b added special Martial Artist support, making this a strong thematic pick.

builds.title: Weakness-exploit builds
builds.description: Any build that reliably creates Open Weakness gets the Soul Eater payoff.

builds.title: Defensive casters
builds.description: The armour, energy shield, life, and intelligence suit hybrid defences.

sections.title: Skill interactions
paragraphs: Untether complements a main skill by adding an on-demand active. Pair it with skills that apply or benefit from weakness reveals.
Because the granted skill level scales with the item, a higher-item-level drop improves Untether directly.
bullets: Use Untether alongside your main damage skill.
Higher item level improves the granted skill.

sections.title: Roll priority
paragraphs: When buying or evaluating a drop, prioritize a high item level (better Untether) and strong defensive rolls (armour, energy shield, life).
Intelligence is valuable if your build is attribute-starved; otherwise weight the defensive lines higher.
bullets: Intelligence -> only if needed for gem requirements.

sections.title: Rare vs unique
paragraphs: A well-rolled rare glove can exceed the raw defensive numbers of The Master's Reach, but it cannot grant Untether or the Soul Eater interaction.
Choose the unique when the granted skill and weakness payoff matter more than squeezing slightly higher defensive rolls from a rare.

sections.title: Use / sell / hold
marketNote: Price depends on item level and roll quality; check the current trade site for your league and region.

use.condition: Your build uses Open Weakness or Martial Artist
text: Use it if the weakness payoff and granted skill fit your build.

sell.condition: You do not need the synergy
sell.first: List on trade with item level shown
text: Sell if another build would benefit more than you.
Hold a good roll in case your build changes.
